issues.quote: revenue rising 14.9% to $281.7 billion from $317.1 billion in fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Microsoft's fiscal 2024 revenue was about $245.1 billion, not $317.1 billion. A drop from $317.1B to $281.7B would be a decline, not a 14.9% rise. Growing from $245.1B to $281.7B does give 14.9%.

data.summary: The analysis is not accurate because of one wrong number: it puts fiscal 2024 revenue at $317.1 billion. The actual figure was about $245.1 billion, and only that figure fits the stated 14.9% growth. The other figures match Microsoft's reported results: gross profit, gross margin, operating income, operating margin, net income and its 15.5% growth, diluted EPS of $13.64 vs. $11.80, and R&D spending.
